title: (Vanilla) CraftEverything
description: Mod adds more than 20 new crafts using vanilla resources.
body:
**This mod adds 25 new crafts!**
Some resources in this mod already had crafting in vanilla Minecraft, but this mod rethinks and simplifies crafting.

You can also craft things like:
- Golden Enchanted Apple
- Player and Ender Dragon Head
- Experience bottle
- Gold, Iron and Diamond Horse Armor
- Totem
- Dragon Egg
- Blaze rod
- Cobweb
- Name Tag
- Leash
- Chainmail
- Trident
- Dead Bush
- Fern
- Debugging Stick
- and even a Light block!

**Use "JEI" mod to make learning new crafts easier.**
